title: Piedras Rojas, Altiplanics Lagoons & Salar Full-Day Tour
pitch: A broad highland circuit combining red rocks, Miscanti and Miñiques, Socaire and the Chaxa flamingo reserve. A strong choice when landscapes are your priority.
pickup: San Pedro accommodation pickup; arrange the return point. The listing places centre drop-off in its exclusions, so confirm this detail.
restrictions: The restrictions panel excludes under-8s and over-70s, pregnancy and several health or mobility conditions. Another note says under-7s; use the stricter limit until confirmed.
caution: Park entry is extra. Around 10 hours, with exposed outdoor stops near 4,200 m.
imageAlt: Red rock beside a highland salt lagoon in the Atacama

reviews.name: Stefan
reviews.summary: Stefan liked the varied stops and plentiful food, but found the outdoor meals windy, chilly and dusty.

reviews.name: João
reviews.summary: João particularly appreciated Celinda’s guiding and help with photographs.

title: Triple tour: Red stones, highland lagoons and Chaxa Lagoon
pitch: A second small-group route through the red rocks and flamingo country. Compare the meal wording and entry-fee arrangements with the Ruta Chile trip.
pickup: Pickup point in San Pedro; confirm your accommodation and exact meeting arrangements.
restrictions: Listed as unsuitable for under-10s, pregnant travellers and people with high blood pressure.
caution: The included food is breakfast and snacks; do not assume a full lunch. Admission paid separately.
imageAlt: Flamingos in a blue lagoon below Andean volcanoes

title: Tatio Geysers at Sunrise | Breakfast & Incredible Landscapes
pitch: An early departure for steam rising through the high Andes, followed by breakfast and wildlife scenery. Save this excursion for later in your stay.
pickup: Pickup normally 04:30–05:10 within urban San Pedro. Nearby ayllus and Toconao are excluded. Confirm central return point and time.
restrictions: Under-9s, over-60s and people with altitude sickness, heart conditions or high blood pressure are excluded by this listing.
caution: El Tatio admission is extra and paid in advance at the agency. Above 4,300 m.
imageAlt: El Tatio at Sunrise — operator listing photograph

reviews.name: Maria
reviews.summary: Maria enjoyed the guides and the overall outing.

reviews.name: Charlotte
reviews.summary: Charlotte liked the combination of geysers, breakfast and wildlife, and praised Anita’s explanations and the advance communication.

title: San Pedro de Atacama: Valle de la Luna Shared Sightseeing Tour
pitch: A lower-price shared excursion to the Amphitheater, Duna Mayor and Tres Marías, with a sunset stop. Best if you can walk to the agency and buy your reserve ticket separately.
pickup: Meet at Tocopilla 418, San Pedro town centre; central drop-off. Verify departure time for your date.
restrictions: Listing excludes children under 8, adults over 70, pregnant travellers and people with mobility impairments.
caution: Reserve entry is extra; buy it before departure as instructed. No hotel pickup.

reviews.name: Kieran
reviews.summary: Kieran appreciated the scenery and Alex’s friendly, engaging guiding.

reviews.name: Steffan
reviews.summary: Steffan described the arrangements as friendly and straightforward.

title: Valle de la Luna
pitch: An easier-to-budget alternative with the Valle de la Luna entrance ticket, snacks and a cocktail included. The itinerary covers the dunes, salt formations and sunset viewpoint.
pickup: Hotel pickup listed; confirm the exact return arrangement, as the description also mentions the town centre.
restrictions: Listing excludes babies under 1, adults over 95 and people with recent surgery. Terrain still requires walking.
caution: Compare the included entrance ticket with cheaper transport-and-guide-only options.
imageAlt: Warm evening light on desert cliffs

reviews.name: Vincent
reviews.summary: Vincent praised Bastian’s explanations and Barbara’s driving during the valley visit.

reviews.name: LIM
reviews.summary: LIM appreciated Lukas’s detailed explanations and enthusiasm for showing the area.

title: San Pedro de Atacama: Stargazing Experience
pitch: An introduction to the southern sky with naked-eye explanations, telescope viewing and a souvenir night photograph. Visible objects depend on season, clouds and moonlight.
pickup: Meeting/pickup depends on option. School E26 is a listed meeting point; return coverage excludes outlying ayllus.
restrictions: Listing excludes children under 4 and adults over 80. Confirm facilities and access before booking.
caution: Choose the correct meeting or pickup option. The bright moon changes what can be observed.
imageAlt: Llama Stargazing Experience — operator listing photograph

reviews.name: Sophie
reviews.summary: Sophie enjoyed the night-sky explanations and opportunities to use the telescope.

reviews.name: Lydia
reviews.summary: Lydia praised the engaging guide and was impressed by the number of stars visible.

title: Atacama: Stargazing & Andean Astronomy with Wine
pitch: Choose this format for both telescope viewing and an explanation of Andean interpretations of the sky, including dark constellations in the Milky Way.
pickup: Meeting and pickup depend on the option booked; confirm your address and return coverage.
restrictions: The listing marks wheelchair accessibility; ask about the specific vehicle and observing-site surface for your needs.
caution: A different interpretive emphasis, not a guarantee of different weather or celestial objects.
imageAlt: Stargazing & Andean Astronomy — operator listing photograph

reviews.name: Mathilde
reviews.summary: Mathilde valued the experienced, enthusiastic guide and felt the activity offered good value.

reviews.name: Katalina
reviews.summary: Katalina appreciated the explanations and practical help with the telescope and photos.

title: Baltinache Hidden Lagoons
pitch: Currently a sightseeing and photography trip around turquoise lagoons, with a Magic Bus stop added during the floating suspension.
pickup: Pickup in San Pedro; current itinerary finishes at Caracoles 600. Confirm your AM or PM option.
restrictions: Listing excludes under-6s and pregnant travellers.
caution: Floating suspended from 29 September 2026. Expected reopening in December has no confirmed date; book for scenery.

title: Cejar Lagoon Tour - Flotation, Cocktail & More!
pitch: A half-day circuit for saltwater floating and the surrounding lagoon scenery, with Ojos del Salar, Tebinquinche and a closing cocktail.
pickup: San Pedro pickup; current itinerary finishes at Caracoles 600.
restrictions: Listing excludes under-6s and pregnant travellers.
caution: Entry fees are extra and collected before departure. Confirm that floating is operating on your date.
imageAlt: A dark blue salt lagoon framed by mountain peaks

reviews.name: GASNIER
reviews.summary: GASNIER found the outing enjoyable and well organised.

reviews.name: JULIAN ALBERTO GARCIA

title: Puritama Hot Springs: Thermal Bath from San Pedro de Atacama
pitch: A transport-led visit to the developed thermal pools at Puritama. Useful when you want a slower half day, but entry is a separate cost.
pickup: San Pedro hotel or designated point. Confirm urban coverage and the return point.
restrictions: No detailed suitability panel captured. Ask about slopes, steps, vehicle access and any health restrictions before reserving.
caution: The thermal-pool entrance ticket is not included in the transport price.
imageAlt: Puritama Hot Springs Transfer — operator listing photograph

title: Best of Atacama: 4 Tours in 3 Days | Combo
shortTitle: Four Atacama Tours in Three Days
pitch: One reservation for El Tatio, Piedras Rojas and the Altiplanic Lagoons, Moon Valley and Baltinache. The operator coordinates the order.
includes: Chaxa, highland lagoons and Piedras Rojas entry
excludes: Moon Valley, El Tatio and Baltinache entry
pickup: Urban San Pedro pickup only. The operator contacts you via WhatsApp to allocate departure days.
restrictions: The generic panel says under-7s, but the El Tatio note prohibits under-9s. Pregnancy, heart/respiratory problems, high blood pressure and wheelchair use are excluded.
caution: Not an all-inclusive holiday. Stargazing, lodging and airport transfers are not listed as included. Baltinache floating suspended.
imageAlt: A blue highland lagoon and Andean mountains

title: 6 Unmissable Tours in 4 Days in Atacama
shortTitle: Six Atacama Tours in Four Days
pitch: An expanded excursion bundle adding Rainbow Valley and Cejar to Moon Valley, Baltinache, Piedras Rojas and El Tatio. Better for breadth than a relaxed schedule.
pickup: Pickup in San Pedro; itinerary ends at Plazoleta La Apacheta. Confirm transfer coverage and guide language.
restrictions: A detailed restriction panel was not captured; check every component, especially El Tatio, before booking.
caution: Only one product rating at the check date. Admission costs are additional; ask specifically about El Tatio entry.
imageAlt: Flamingos in a blue lagoon below Andean volcanoes

title: San Pedro de Atacama: 4-Day Uyuni Salt Flats Tour
pitch: A cross-border expedition through Bolivia’s high lagoons and Salar de Uyuni, returning to San Pedro on day four. Basic accommodation and long driving days are part of the format.
pickup: Listed meeting point: White & Green Travel, Caracoles 179 D. Reconfirm pickup and return logistics.
restrictions: Listing excludes pregnant travellers, people with back problems and wheelchair users. Route approaches 5,000 m. Spanish-speaking driver.
caution: This is the return-to-San-Pedro product, not a one-way three-day ticket. Confirm border documents for your nationality.
imageAlt: Four-Day Uyuni Return Trip — operator listing photograph

title: Calama Airport: Transfer to/from San Pedro de Atacama
pitch: A shared or private transfer between El Loa Airport and your San Pedro accommodation. Reserve the correct direction and provide your flight and hotel details.
includes: One suitcase and one carry-on per person
pickup: Airport arrivals exit/name board, or hotel pickup for departures. Driver language listed as Spanish.
restrictions: Not wheelchair accessible in the current listing. Oversize luggage is not allowed.
caution: The starting price is the listing minimum, not a private-vehicle quote. Choose the option and direction before paying.
imageAlt: An unpaved road through the Atacama Desert
